repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 間接機轉：Azelaic acid 為酒渣鼻核准藥物，而 Demodex 螨蟲定植與酒渣鼻發病高度相關（但 azelaic acid 對 Demodex 本身無直接抗寄生蟲活性，主要透過抗炎及抗菌機制間接改善症狀）。TxGNN 預測可能捕捉到此間接關聯。
Azelaic acid 的抗真菌活性主要針對 Malassezia（親脂性酵母菌），對 Candida 的體外抑制資料極為有限。機轉關聯薄弱，缺乏臨床支持。
扁平苔蘚為免疫介導疾病（T 細胞媒介），azelaic acid 的抗炎機轉（抑制 ROS、中性球活化）具微弱機轉假說，但家族性扁平苔蘚涉及基因易感性，缺乏任何直接臨床或文獻支持。
血漿鋅升高為實驗室異常值，而非疾病實體；azelaic acid 與鋅代謝之間無已知機轉關聯。TxGNN 高分可能源自知識圖譜中皮膚科適應症的間接網絡連結，臨床生物學意義極低。
先天性指紋缺失症為罕見遺傳性皮膚病（SMARCAD1 基因突變），以皮膚附屬器發育異常為主，與 azelaic acid 的作用機轉（抗菌、抗角化、抗炎）無任何交集。預測可能為知識圖譜雜訊。

literature.title: Azelaic Acid: Evidence-based Update on Mechanism of Action and Clinical Application.
literature.journal: Journal of drugs in dermatology : JDD
literature.abstract: Azelaic acid is a complex molecule with many diverse activities. The latter include anti-infective and anti-inflammatory action. The agent also inhibits follicular keratinization and epidermal melanogenesis. Due to the wide variety of biological activities, azelaic acid has been utilized as a management tool in a broad spectrum of disease states and cutaneous disorders. This paper reviews the clinical utility of azelaic acid, noting the quality of the evidence supporting each potential use.

literature.title: Periorificial dermatitis in infants and preschoolers - a narrative review.
literature.abstract: Periorifical dermatitis (POD) is a papular, chronic inflammatory skin disease commonly seen in women in their 2nd to 4th decade of life. The major differential diagnosis is persistent acne. In children, POD is less common than in adults. In infants and preschoolers POD is rare. We performed a narrative review for POD in children ≤6 years of age. Diagnosis is clinical. The disease presents with monomorphic erythematous papules that usually leave a 1-2 mm Grenz zone around the red lips unaffected.

literature.title: Minor derm ailments: how good is the evidence for common treatments?
literature.abstract: Oral flucloxacillin is less effective than local antibiotics for impetigo in limited disease. Topical metronidazole and azelaic acid are effective for rosacea. Betadine is effective for minor infections following partial thickness burns. Terbinafine is effective against fungal infections of the nail. Miconazole is effective against oral thrush.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 體癬由皮癬菌（dermatophytes）引起，azelaic acid 對皮癬菌的直接抗真菌活性缺乏充分體外資料；現有文獻（PMID 20347661）僅討論皮癬菌病理機轉，並未涉及 azelaic acid 治療。機轉關聯極為間接。
Beare-Stevenson 症候群為 FGFR2 基因突變引起的罕見先天性顱縫早閉症候群，其皮膚病理（cutis gyrata, acanthosis nigricans）源於異常受體酪胺酸激酶訊號。Azelaic acid 無 FGFR2 抑制活性，機轉關聯評估為不相關。
